# Agent Oak

> Agent Oak is a family finance and preparedness app: a guided, step-by-step
> response plan for job loss, medical emergencies, retirement, and other life
> events — built from a family's own data, not generic advice. Informational
> and educational only; not financial, investment, tax, or legal advice, and
> not a substitute for professional emergency services.

Agent Oak is free to start, with no credit card required. It is not an
autonomous financial agent — it does not move money, execute trades, or take
action on a family's behalf without a human approving each step.

## Core features (free)

- Emergency Mode — a one-tap, guided checklist for a specific crisis (medical
  emergency, job loss, bereavement, disability), not a generic FAQ.
- "What happens if...?" scenarios — a specific answer built from what the
  family has told Oak, not a canned response.
- Family Readiness Score — a snapshot across protection, wealth, goals, and
  savings, read from the family's own data: https://agent-oak.ai/readiness
- Document upload and secure storage for insurance policies, pension
  statements, and other financial documents.
- Connect any email provider (Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, iCloud, or a custom
  domain) so Oak can watch for financial mail.
- A multi-person family roster — one household's data, not five separate
  accounts.

## Oak Plus (paid, £7.99/month)

- AI reads uploaded documents and extracts the provider, policy number,
  amount, and dates automatically.
- AI-summarized inbox — financial emails explained in plain language as they
  arrive.
- Priority support.

## Trust and data handling

- Connector passwords and access tokens are encrypted at rest, not just in
  transit.
- Financial data is never sold and is not used to train models beyond the
  request that needs it.
- Users can ask to have their account and data deleted; this is currently
  handled by a person, not a self-serve flow.
